purpose: Bounded retrieval of possible external parallels for Huntington 5 Ezekiel 36:23; not source-priority adjudication

selection.ot_member_rule: Members ending .tt whose first two filename characters, parsed as an integer, are in the explicit prefix list; no second export format
selection.monastic_rule: Recursive tree paths ending .tt with top-level directory starting shenoute- or in monastic_directories; exclude meta.json[filename stem].redundant == yes, defaulting missing metadata to empty; then inspect each actual header
selection.scope_limit: Selected Pentateuch/prophetic collections and monastic corpora only. Ezekiel, Malachi, other unselected OT books, NT and other literature are outside this screen. Document counts do not imply complete chapters or complete works.

query.norm_layer: norm attributes on norm elements, in document order
query.orig_layer: orig attributes on orig elements in monastic inputs; orig attributes on norm elements in OT inputs, in document order
query.transformation: HTML character-reference decoding; casefold; Unicode NFD; remove Mn/Mc/Me and whitespace; concatenate within each document, retaining punctuation; exact substring retrieval
query.initial_parser_correction: The first pass omitted OT norm@orig attributes. Corrected before final conclusions; the same cached inputs were rerun and both layers independently reproduced.

retrieved_loci.assessment: Fainthearted/cowardly in a temptation context, not numerical reduction through scattering; not the target sequence

validation: Root independently reproduced all 585 input SHA256 hashes, both token totals and four layer hits. Exact selection, archive and metadata plus all 211 monastic file Git blob IDs match the complete pinned upstream tree. Actual hit contexts inspected.
rights: OT files declare CC BY-SA 4.0; both hit files declare CC BY 4.0. Other source-specific licenses remain applicable. No full third-party text or archive imported into POB.
decision: No identified donor in returned contexts; no Hebrew, English, note or canon change. No proof of donor nonexistence, independent OT attestation or historical priority. OT metadata declares Crosswire/CoptOT dependence.
